summary: verify is the one verb for plans built in Python, recheck is dropped, and from_substrait is the constructor for a plan loaded from Substrait.
note: Narrowed 2026-11-22 by ruling 261: verify no longer takes a stored Substrait plan, and substrait_export.recheck becomes private (#2344, PR #2352). The ruling first read: "verify is the one verb for plans built in Python or loaded from Substrait, recheck is dropped, and from_substrait is a constructor."
